Download ArafatVoice-Android.apk. An eligible ChatGPT account and internet are required. No API-key setup or separately billed API fallback. Account eligibility and existing plan limits apply.

FIRST USE

Install. Connect. Send a message.

  1. 01

    Check installation

    Open the voice APK. Keep Play Protect and Advanced Protection enabled. If either blocks installation, stop and report the warning. Removing sensitive access does not guarantee installation approval.

  2. 02

    Continue with ChatGPT

    Sign in in the official browser page and allow Use your ChatGPT plan if offered. Return to the app and select an available model. Live account sign-in still needs a local trial.

  3. 03

    Review before Send

    Choose a dictation language, speak, then check the transcript before Send message. Your phone’s speech provider supplies dictation and may process audio online. You can also type or paste text.

A deliberately limited edition

Messages and text replies

Ask for explanations, translations or help with text you supply. Links are not fetched. There is no background listening or spoken-response feature.

No access to other apps

No accessibility service, screen reading, app control, SMS or notification access. The APK declares only the internet permission.

Conversation stays in memory

Up to eight completed exchanges supply recent context. New conversation, a model change or process loss clears it. Your existing ChatGPT conversations are not imported.

A personal preview

Automated checks inspect the APK and use Android emulators. They do not establish Play Protect approval or test sign-in and real dictation on your phone. This debug-signed APK is distributed outside Google Play.
